end.parentNote: Asha practised placing BCE and CE dates on a timeline and ordering several dates. Aarav used the method that larger BCE numbers come earlier, and correctly ordered the four dates. They asked how to cross-check sources and whether a book is always fully correct; this was not revisited in the recorded turns (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, practise ordering three BCE/CE dates and discuss checking one fact in two sources.
